description: Build the client-side UI: Index.html shell, Banner.html partial (hero with inline-SVG illustration and member buttons), Stylesheet.html (elegant teal-and-pink theme, glassmorphism cards, responsive layout, smooth transitions), and Javascript.html (google.script.run wiring with mock-data fallback for direct preview, ECharts-driven 3D-style charts with animations, KPI cards for all 5 resources, and a sortable/searchable filtered data table). Loads ECharts and a Google Font from CDNs at runtime in the user's browser. Depends on FEAT-001 (server functions and include() helper).

Create `apps-script/Index.html`. It must be a complete HTML5 document. . The buttons inside `#memberButtons` are populated by client JS (one button per member returned by getMembers() plus an 'All' button which is selected by default). Include role=tab and aria-selected attributes for accessibility. Do NOT hardcode the member names in the HTML - they come from the server (or the JS mock fallback).

Create `apps-script/Stylesheet.html`. Wrap everything in a single <style>...</style> block. Define CSS custom properties for the theme: --teal #0fb5a8 (echo of the sheet's separator), --teal-dark #0a857c, --pink #ffd6e0 (echo of the title row), --pink-strong #ff6b9a, --bg-0 #0f1720, --bg-1 #131c27, --surface rgba(255,255,255,0.06), --surface-strong rgba(255,255,255,0.10), --text #eaf2f4, --muted #9fb1bd, --shadow 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.35). Apply a body background that is a soft animated gradient between teal and pink at low opacity over a dark base. Define: `.banner` (full-width hero, padding 48px, position relative, overflow hidden, gradient backdrop, rounded bottom corners, the SVG positioned absolute right and partially clipped); `.member-buttons` (flex, gap, wrap); `.member-buttons button` (glassmorphism: backdrop-filter blur(12px), translucent surface, 1px border with subtle white at low alpha, rounded-full, padding 10px 18px, transition transform 200ms and box-shadow 200ms, hover lifts -2px, `.is-active` state has the pink-strong border and a subtle inner glow). Charts section: 3-column responsive grid with `grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr` collapsing to single column under 900px, each chart card has the glassmorphism surface, height 360px for chart3d and 280px for the others. Cards section: `#cardsGrid` is a CSS grid `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))` with gap 16px, `.kpi-card` has the glassmorphism surface, padding 20px, border-radius 18px, transition for transform/box-shadow, hover lifts -4px and increases shadow, contains an `.avatar` 48px circle with a 2-letter initial colored from a deterministic hash of the member name. Table: full-width inside a glass surface, sticky header, zebra striping with low-alpha rows, status pills `.pill.completed` (teal background) and `.pill.in-progress` (pink-strong background) and `.pill.bug` (amber). Provide @keyframes fadeUp (translateY(8px)->0, opacity 0->1) and apply it to .kpi-card and chart cards with staggered animation-delay (use nth-child). Include @media (max-width: 720px) collapsing layouts. Ensure focus-visible outlines for keyboard users.

Create `apps-script/Javascript.html`. Wrap everything in a single <script>...</script> block. Implement: (a) a `runServer(fn, ...args)` helper that returns a Promise. If `typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run` exists it bridges via withSuccessHandler/withFailureHandler; otherwise it resolves with mock data from a built-in `MOCK` object that contains realistic rows for all 5 members across 3 dates matching the screenshot (Isra, Sowmiya, Keerthana, Yogesh, Tamizharasi; clients Humana/Nasdaq/Internal/Worldpay; mix of COMPLETED and IN-PROGRESS, billability YES/NO, hours 0.5..6, a few bug captures). (b) State object `{ members:[], selected:'All', tasksByMember:{}, summaries:[], chartData:null }`. (c) `init()` async: parallel `Promise.all([runServer('getMembers'), runServer('getAllTasks'), runServer('getAllSummaries'), runServer('getChartData')])`, populates state, then renderButtons(), renderCards(), renderCharts(), renderTable(), updates `#updatedAt` to a localized timestamp. Wrap in try/catch; on failure render an inline non-blocking banner saying 'Showing sample data' and use MOCK. (d) `renderButtons()` builds an 'All' button + one per member into `#memberButtons`, attaches click handlers that set state.selected and re-render. Active button gets `.is-active` and `aria-selected=true`. (e) `renderCards()` clears `#cardsGrid` and appends a `.kpi-card` per member showing avatar (initials, hash-color background), name, and 6 KPIs (Tasks, Hours, Billable Hrs, Completed, In-Progress, Bugs). Whole card is clickable and selects that member. Stagger animation-delay using inline style (`element.style.animationDelay = (i*60)+'ms'`). (f) `renderCharts()` initializes 3 ECharts instances (kept in a module-scope object so we can `dispose()` and `setOption()` on filter change). chart3d uses ECharts-GL `bar3D` series for hours-per-member with `grid3D` (light teal/pink color stops) and `animationDuration: 1200`; if echarts-gl failed to load, gracefully fall back to a 2D bar with shadow + perspective transform. chartStatus is a doughnut (Completed vs In-Progress) with `animationDuration: 900` and a center label showing total tasks. chartTrend is a smooth area line of hours per day for the selected member or 'all'. Each chart `resize()` is wired to window resize. (g) `renderTable()` builds the <thead> dynamically (S No, Date, Client, Project, Hours, Billability, Status, Bugs, Description; plus a Member column when state.selected==='All'). Body rows are appended with status pills and a small bug count badge if noOfBugs > 0. Sorting: clicking a <th> toggles asc/desc on that column (numeric for Hours/Bugs, lexical for others, date-aware for Date). Search: `#tableSearch` filters rows live (case-insensitive substring across all visible columns). (h) On state.selected change, re-run renderCards highlight, renderCharts (with selected-only data for chartTrend, recomputed status/bugs etc.), and renderTable. (i) Defensive: every read from state is null/undefined-checked, dates are formatted via a small `fmtDate(iso)` helper, hours via `fmtHours(n)` returning 'h' suffix and 1 decimal max. (j) Avatar color hash: simple djb2 over the name -> HSL with fixed saturation/lightness so colors are vivid but consistent. (k) On DOMContentLoaded call init().

Sanity-check sizes: `wc -l apps-script/Index.html apps-script/Banner.html apps-script/Stylesheet.html apps-script/Javascript.html` and confirm none are empty (each should be at least ~30 lines, Stylesheet and Javascript well over 100).

Confirm CDN URLs are HTTPS (`grep -nE 'src="http://' apps-script/Index.html` should produce no matches) and that ECharts + echarts-gl + Google Fonts links are present (`grep -nE 'echarts(@|-gl)|fonts.googleapis.com' apps-script/Index.html` should show all three).
acceptance_criteria: Index.html includes Stylesheet, Banner, and Javascript via the Apps Script include() scriptlet and pulls ECharts + echarts-gl + a Google Font from CDNs over HTTPS.
Banner.html renders the hero, an inline SVG illustration (no remote images), and an empty `#memberButtons` container that the JS populates from getMembers().
Stylesheet.html implements the teal/pink themed glassmorphism look with KPI card hover lift, status pills, responsive grid, and fadeUp keyframe animation.
Javascript.html exposes a `runServer` bridge that uses google.script.run when present and falls back to a built-in MOCK dataset otherwise, so the page renders standalone for design preview.

Three ECharts charts are initialized: a 3D-style bar (hours per member), a doughnut (status breakdown), and a smooth line (hours per day). All animate on load and on filter change. Window resize triggers chart.resize().
Five (or N, driven by getMembers()) KPI cards render with avatar, name, and the 6 KPIs; clicking a card or a banner button filters charts + table.
The data table supports column sorting, live search, status pills, and adds a Member column when 'All' is selected.
No `console.error` is produced under the mock fallback path (the page is openable as a static file for review).
verification: Every `include('X')` reference resolves to an existing `apps-script/X.html` (Python check from the steps).
`grep -n 'google.script.run' apps-script/Javascript.html` matches AND `grep -n 'MOCK' apps-script/Javascript.html` matches (proving the fallback exists).
`grep -n '#memberButtons' apps-script/Banner.html apps-script/Javascript.html` shows the container in Banner and population in JS.
`grep -nE 'class="(kpi-card|pill|banner|member-buttons)"' apps-script/*.html` finds all four class names somewhere across the files.
`git status --porcelain` shows only additions/changes inside apps-script/ and .agents/tasks/; src/, bin/, and the top-level README.md are unchanged.
findings: Implemented client UI under apps-script/. Files added: Index.html (HTML5 shell, charset/viewport, Plus Jakarta Sans via fonts.googleapis.com, ECharts 5 + ECharts-GL 2 over HTTPS, sections for charts/cards/table, footer with #updatedAt, includes Stylesheet/Banner/Javascript via <?!= include() ?>); Banner.html (hero partial with inline-SVG illustration in teal/pink gradients - no remote images, h1 'QA - Daily Status', tagline, empty #memberButtons role=tablist populated by JS); Stylesheet.html (single <style> block: theme custom properties teal/teal-dark/pink/pink-strong/amber/dark bg, glassmorphism .glass, banner with animated blobs, member-buttons with .is-active state, charts grid 2fr 1fr 1fr collapsing under 900px, chart3d 360px / others 280px, KPI grid auto-fit minmax(220px,1fr), .kpi-card hover lift -4px and .is-selected state, sticky table thead + zebra rows, .pill.completed/.pill.in-progress/.pill.bug, .bug-badge, fadeUp keyframe with nth-child staggered delays, @media 720px breakpoint, focus-visible outlines, prefers-reduced-motion handling); Javascript.html (single <script> IIFE: runServer Promise bridge that uses google.script.run.withSuccessHandler/withFailureHandler when available and falls back to a built-in MOCK with 5 members x 4 rows mixing Humana/Nasdaq/Internal/Worldpay, COMPLETED/IN-PROGRESS, billability YES/NO, hours 0.5..6 and bug captures; state {members,selected,tasksByMember,summaries,chartData,sort,search}; init() Promise.all over getMembers/getAllTasks/getAllSummaries/getChartData with try/catch -> showMockNotice fallback; renderButtons builds 'All' + per-member tabs with role=tab/aria-selected; renderCards builds .kpi-card per member with avatar (hash-color HSL via djb2), name, 6 KPIs (Tasks/Hours/Billable Hrs/Completed/In-Progress/Bugs) - Billable Hrs is RECOMPUTED from raw rows where billability==='YES' because the server's summarize_() checks 'BILLABLE' which never matches the YES/NO sheet (comment left in code explaining the discrepancy); renderCharts initializes three module-scope ECharts instances - chart3d as bar3D with viewControl/light/visualMap teal->pink and animationDuration 1200, with a guarded try/catch fallback to a 2D bar with linear gradient + shadow if echarts-gl failed to load, chartStatus as doughnut with center-label total tasks animationDuration 900, chartTrend as smooth area line for selected member or 'all'; window resize triggers chart.resize(); renderTable builds <thead> dynamically (adds Member column when selected==='All'), status pills + bug-count badge in cells, click-to-sort with asc/desc toggle (numeric for Hours/Bugs, date-aware for Date, lexical otherwise), live #tableSearch case-insensitive substring filter; selection change re-runs button highlight, card highlight, charts and table; helpers fmtDate, fmtHours, hashHsl, escapeHtml, defensive null-checks; init wired via DOMContentLoaded). All FEAT-002 verification commands pass: python include resolver returns missing:[], grep finds echarts.min.js, echarts-gl, google.script.run, MOCK, #memberButtons (Banner+JS), and all four class names kpi-card/pill/banner/member-buttons; no http:// (only https) in Index; git diff --stat src/ bin/ README.md is empty; git status shows only additions inside apps-script/ and a status update inside .agents/. No node available so no JS lint was run, but brace/paren/bracket counts balance and <script>...</script> tags are balanced. ECharts/Fonts CDNs intentionally referenced in <link>/<script src> form for runtime-in-browser fetch; INTEGRATIONS_ONLY at build time is unaffected.
